title: Re-Zombies
description: New Zombies to minecraft even some Survivors
body:
Re-Zombies is a mod inspired by Mo-Zombies that sadly hasn't been updated sense 2015.
this mod requires the mod KNJ-LIB


Re-Zombies is a mod that was codded from scratch, that adds more Zombies with new skins and abilities to Minecraft and some new items.



Zombie Notch

- Does 999 Damge
- Doesn't burn in daylight
- Drops Apples
- Rare Drops Golden apples
- Will Attack Zombie Herobrine

Zombie Miner

- Doesn't Burn in daylight
- Drops cobblestone
- Rare drops miner helmet

Zombie Creeper

- Burns in daylight
- Rare drops TNT
- Will Attack Villagers

Zombie Pirate

- Doesn't burn in daylight
- Drops gold nuggest
- Rare Drop gold ingot

Zombie Pa

- Very Strong
- Doesn't Burn in daylight
- Rare drop leather

Nether Zombie

- Lives in the nether
- Fire Proof
- Drops Rotten flesh

Zombie Cyborg

- Doesn't Burn in daylight
- Rare drop is redstone

Zombie Dwarf

- Burns in daylight
- Drops coal

Zombie Herobrine

- Fire Proof
- Very Fast
- Will attack Zombie Notch

Zombie King

- Doesn't Burn in daylight
- Walks slow
- Rare Drop his Armour

Zombie Knight

- Doesn't Burn in daylight
- Walks slow
- Rare drop His armour

Disco Zombie

- Burns in daylight
- Rare drop noteblocks

Zombie Chef

- Doesn't Burn in daylight
- Drops mushroom stew
- Rare drop Rabbit Stew

Survivor 

- Friendly unless attacked
- Will follow you if you give them food untill you right click them again
- Will attack mobs



I am planing on adding more Zombies and Items if you have any ideas please come and say in my Discord
